gen-gf-finger-paint-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One has a tall middle band with shallow ascenders and descenders, and a generous entry into the e's eye. Over a long page it stays literary and dignified beside Finger Paint's blunt heading.
gen-gf-finger-paint-gf-hanuman: Finger Paint sets bold-looking and light-looking strokes apart, never mixing them within a word, and its crossbars match its stems. Hanuman's high-waisted text serif is the quiet partner.
gen-gf-finger-paint-gf-kadwa: Kadwa reads classic and editorial, with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height that fills the line. But the longer the text runs, the more Finger Paint's bowls, drawn at stem thickness, feel like a bold stamp above it.
gen-gf-finger-paint-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text reads literary and dignified, with a big visible entrance into each curved letter and lowercase bodies filling most of the height. And Finger Paint, drawn at a single track width like neon tube, sits above it as the loud, commanding partner.
gen-gf-finger-paint-gf-piazzolla: Finger Paint's capitals barely outrank its tall bodies. Piazzolla is the text serif beneath, refined and authoritative, its lowercase nearly matching capitals, so let it run a touch smaller than you would expect.
gen-gf-finger-paint-gf-pridi: Commanding, certainly, but Pridi softens things below it. Finger Paint is best at bold, shading-free statements, while Pridi, a refined serif with generous space between curve ends and stem, is best at carrying the quieter lines.
gen-gf-finger-paint-gf-scope-one: Refined and traditional, Scope One has counters that spill into the space around them. And across a long page its stubby ascenders and big x-height hold steady under Finger Paint's bowls, which never thin at the sides.
gen-gf-finger-paint-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px reads bookish and dignified, with large open counters in its tall a, e and s. Slabo 13px stays clear and comfortable across a long page, while Finger Paint's stems match its nonexistent hairlines above.
gen-gf-finger-paint-gf-suwannaphum: Finger Paint cuts every stroke end as if from the same ribbon, and its crossbars are as thick as its stems. But Suwannaphum, a dignified text serif with an x-height like a squared-off woodblock letter, keeps a long page editorial.
